grantsData.title: Change the world — get support for good causes
grantsData.description: The DoGood grant program was created to support volunteer, social, environmental and innovative initiatives.

title: What Are DoGood Grants?
description: DoGood Grants provide financial and resource support for people, organizations, and communities driving positive change. Our mission is to make kindness visible, scalable, and achievable for everyone.
description1: Whether you're launching a local initiative, scaling environmental action, or building innovative solutions for good — we're here to fuel your impact.

types.desc-1: Quick help for small good deeds

types.desc-2: Support for initiatives for communities, schools, pensioners

types.desc-3: Support for shelters and independent activists

transparency.type-1: Each application undergoes an ethical review
transparency.desc-1: We carefully evaluate each project to ensure it aligns with our values, causes no harm to communities, and delivers meaningful social impact. Decisions are made transparently, with input from independent experts.

transparency.type-2: Each application undergoes an ethical review
transparency.desc-2: Financial transparency is our priority. Donors can see exactly how funds are used — from materials and logistics to direct support for beneficiaries. Regular reports are available online.

transparency.desc-3: Each project includes an impact assessment: how many people were helped, what changed in communities, and the stories behind the numbers. We believe trust is built through action — and we’re ready to show it.

items.question: What types of grants are available on the platform?
Who can apply for a grant?
Does DoGood provide funding directly?
Does the platform guarantee funding?
How do I apply for a grant?
items.answer:
1. Register on the platform.
2. Select the "Apply for a Grant" section.
3. Fill out the application form.
4. Submit your application. After that, it will become available for review by grantmakers.

items.question: Can I apply for multiple grants?
items.answer: Yes. You can submit one universal application or adapt it to the requirements of specific programs.

items.question: How are projects selected?
How long does the review process take?
items.answer:
Timelines depend on the specific program. Typically:
• Fast grants: 1–3 weeks;
• Large programs: 4–8 weeks.
You will be automatically notified of any changes to your application status.

items.question: How is the grant amount determined?
items.answer: The amount depends on the scale of the project, the justified budget, and the grantmaker's capacity. Each program has its own funding limits.

items.question: Is reporting required?
items.answer:
Yes. Grantees are required to:
• Provide reports on the targeted use of funds;
• Demonstrate the social impact achieved.
The reporting format depends on the terms of the specific grantmaker.

items.question: How can I increase my chances of getting funded?
Are there any platform fees?
items.answer: In the early stages, most platform features are free. In the future, service fees or premium features may be introduced to expand user capabilities.
